Welcome to Eden Royal

A marquee made for once-in-a-lifetime days

Eden Royal Marquee is built around one idea — your celebration should feel effortless. Step into soaring, gold-lit halls, a stage dressed to your theme, and a team that quietly handles every detail while you enjoy your own party.

  • ✓Grand, fully air-conditioned halls with chandelier lighting
  • ✓Separate Day and Night function slots, every single day
  • ✓Decor, stage and seating styled to your event theme
  • ✓Dedicated event team on the floor from start to finish

Hall Details

Manage Halls

Add each hall with its name and hall number (e.g. Hall 1, Hall 2, Royal Hall). Added halls appear in the booking form's hall dropdown, and double-booking is prevented separately for each hall.

👤 Account & Login

Create a free OAuth Client ID in Google Cloud Console for this site's address, then paste it here. Signing in with Google uses the account registered with that Google email — a brand-new Google account is sent to the admin for approval first, like any other signup.

🔒 PIN Lock

Set a 4-digit PIN to lock the app on open. Leave empty to remove.

Backup & Restore

All data is saved in the shared online database — the same data shows on the website and in the app after login. Download a backup file regularly and keep it safe.
